description: Send a message. Send text, a WhatsApp template, a reaction, or a typing indicator on any channel. Route by conversation_id, by platform plus platform_user_id, or by to_phone for SMS and WhatsApp. SMS, WhatsApp and Telegram can start a conversation cold; Facebook and Instagram need an inbound message first. idempotency_key is required in the body, or send the Idempotency-Key header. This reaches a real person on their phone. Confirm the recipient and the text with the user before calling.

idempotency_key.description: Required unless the Idempotency-Key header is sent. A replay returns the original result with status duplicate.

platform.description: With platform_user_id, route by the channel identity.

to_phone.description: E.164. SMS and WhatsApp only. Starts a conversation if none exists.

name: send_message
